summary: Fortinet FortiMail email gateway, Enterprise ATP bundle: anti-spam, antivirus and DLP plus a sandbox, attachment disarm and link protection.
value: Unknown malicious attachments are stopped in the sandbox, and the person gets a sanitised copy.
Links are checked at click time, and sender impersonation is recognised.
Confidential data does not quietly leave by email.
simple: Fortinet FortiMail email gateway as a hardware appliance (FML-200F – FML-3000F) or a virtual machine (VM01 – VM32) for your own data center or cloud; sits in front of any mail server as a gateway, runs transparently or as a mail server itself. FortiGuard antispam (99.99% of spam per vendor data) based on sender reputation, links and behavior, multi-layer antivirus, protection against new threat outbreaks, inbound and outbound filtering, SPF, DKIM and DMARC checks, secure delivery (TLS), recipient email encryption (IBE), email data loss prevention (DLP) by keywords, patterns and file fingerprints, and reporting. The Enterprise ATP bundle adds protection against targeted attacks: removing active content from attachments (CDR), click-time URL protection, impersonation analysis against business email compromise (BEC) and the FortiMail cloud sandbox. A separate bundle with the Cloud Email API also scans Microsoft 365 and Google mailboxes in real time and pulls back already delivered emails if a threat is discovered later.
classification: CDR, URL Click Protection, Impersonation Analysis and Cloud Sandboxing are the sandbox class.
The bundle with Cloud Email API stays in the text.
